select FLX_ANN_MOI as month, sum(PRS_REM_MNT) as amount, sum(PRS_REM_MNT) - lag(sum(PRS_REM_MNT)) over (order by FLX_ANN_MOI) as change
from ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS
where PSE_ACT_SNDS = 50
group by FLX_ANN_MOI
order by FLX_ANN_MOI
